qualitative.gate_2_reason: Highly discretionary, weather-dependent seasonal indulgence easily forgone; lacks daily habitual necessity or non-discretionary consumer staple loyalty.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Essential Western Need, REJECT). Operates as a seasonal, weather-dependent indulgence (Magnum, Ben & Jerry's, Cornetto, Wall's) that is easily forgone or substituted during economic downturns, lacking the essential daily ritual or inelastic habit of coffee or core grocery staples.
qualitative.evidence: Spun off from Unilever in December 2025 as a standalone ice cream business. While holding iconic consumer indulgence brands (Magnum, Ben & Jerry's, Wall's/Algida) with prominent freezer-cabinet placement, revenue and cash flows remain intensely weather-dependent and seasonal. The category suffers from high cold-chain capital intensity, retailer price sensitivity, and high consumer elasticity during periods of disposable income pressure.
